analysis:
This PR only changes documentation: docs/provider/cluster-always-on.md and docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md. No code, config or policy changes are in the supplied evidence. The docs now describe an automatic coordinated update for a two-Mac cluster (supervisor-run AutoUpdateController cycle, pair drain, install, start check via `darkbloom --version`, rollback and quarantine). They replace the earlier statement that pairs do not update automatically.

Security-relevant claims the next pass should check against the implementation, which is not supplied here:
- The update path reuses the single-Mac SelfUpdater verification. Download, verify and stage must preserve the signature and identity checks, and the staged artifact must be tied to the qualified build (T-034, T-054, A-017).
- The supervisor restarts itself with execv into the installed binary. No watchdog outlives the restart, so rollback authority is the same replaceable binary and the T-043 limitation applies (docs/provider/cluster-always-on.md lines 164-181). The start check only proves `--version` exits 0 and prints the release version. It does not prove the binary is trustworthy, and an attacker-modified binary could pass it. The check should not be read as integrity assurance.
- The pair's progress is exchanged over the cluster link (`ClusterPairUpdateProgress` via service status). The docs do not say whether that channel is authenticated or how a stale or forged partner state is handled (lines 130 and 147-151). A rule that a Mac goes on alone when no cluster worker runs is a policy claim to verify.
- The drain never cancels accepted requests and reopens admission on the same coordinator connection (lines 144-146). Check the interaction with T-053 (stale authorization and connection changes) and with the App Attest serving authorization A-016 on re-registration under the new cluster approval.
- A divergent-version state is documented as possible after a failed start check on one Mac. Check coordinator gating of mixed builds (T-054).

No concrete regression is demonstrable from the doc text alone, so there are no findings. needs_deeper_review is true because the implementation files named in the docs (ClusterPairUpdateCycle, ClusterPairUpdate, ClusterCandidateRecovery, ClusterServiceCommand) were not supplied, and the threat model has no entry for this new update-authority surface.
